pageDescription: Information about the facilities and services available at PT. Equityworld Futures

services.title: Professional Futures Broker Representatives
services.description: EWF is supported by certified Futures Broker Representatives who meet Bappebti’s competency and credibility standards, ensuring every client receives professional guidance.

services.title: 2FA Security System
services.description: To protect every transaction, EWF’s online trading system is equipped with Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) using One Time Password (OTP) as an additional security layer during login.

services.title: Online Trading & Demo Account
services.description: A responsive online trading platform equipped with real-time price spreads, interactive charts, and up-to-date market information. A Demo Account is also available so prospective clients can practice before entering real trading.

services.title: Online Registration
services.description: Prospective clients can open an account more conveniently through the online registration service on EWF’s official website, simplifying the onboarding process without the need to visit the office.

services.title: Daily Transaction Reports
services.description: All client trading activities are automatically sent via email as a daily statement, providing full transparency for every transaction.

services.title: Fund Withdrawal
services.description: Fund withdrawals can be requested online and are generally processed within one business day (T+1) after all requirements are fulfilled, offering convenience and speed for clients.

services.title: Segregated Account
services.description: Client funds are placed in a Segregated Account in accordance with Bappebti regulations, ensuring fund security and complete separation from the company’s own assets.

services.title: Transaction Flexibility
services.description: Investors can take advantage of both rising and falling price movements, supported by high liquidity and direct access to various trading instruments.

services.title: Dispute Resolution
services.description: All customer complaints are handled in line with Bappebti Regulation Number 4 of 2020, ensuring a fair, structured, and well-documented resolution process.

services.title: Sitna Program
services.description: EWF provides clients with access to monitor their trading activities through the Customer Transaction Information System (SITNA) at the Jakarta Futures Exchange and Indonesia Clearing House, as a form of transparency and accountability.
